LIBERTY FORGE EXPEDITION CAMPER SERIES

Forged for freedom. Built for adventure.

A made-in-the-USA camper shell on a welded tube steel trailer platform. Light enough at 960 lbs. to tow with the rig you already own.

  • Shell lengths: 79" or 89" sloped, 89" flat pod
  • 12VDC rooftop AC with heat; solar panel ready
  • Timbren 2000 lb. independent suspension
